description:
The Nikke in charge of cooking in Cooking Oil Squad.
Not only has she been conducting endless research to recreate food from the surface perfectly using Splendamin, she also hosts a cooking program.
For her, eating is a great pleasure in life, so every meal must be perfect.

costumes.name: Treat Chef
costumes.description:
Crust costume.
Obtained from a Mission Pass.

lines.text: I've prepared a multi-course meal today, all centered around seafood! You're gonna love it, hehe.

I'm also the host of the Crunchy Cooking Class.
If you have some free time, be sure to check it out!

I'm in charge of cooking, and Bready is in charge of tasting. 
It's a match made in heaven!
I wonder what you'll think of today's dish? My heart is beating like crazy!

You're welcome to visit the kitchen anytime, Mr. Gourmand!
Very few people have that kind of access, so be sure not to tell anyone!

I've made a special dish just for you, Mr. Gourmand.
Enjoy!
Mr. Gourmand? Where did you go? It's almost time to eat.

I packed you a warm meal in this lunchbox!
Make sure to eat it when you get back, hehe.

I'm hard at work researching various dishes.
Be sure to encourage me whenever you can!

You should never skip a meal!
You need to eat well to have energy!

There don't seem to be many restaurants at the Outpost.
Is everyone here getting enough to eat?
I, Crust, will make loads of delicious dishes for you!
Wow, I feel like I'll be able to make more dishes than ever!
Wow, this is...! I just thought of an incredible recipe!
I feel a tingling in my fingertips. Could it be... my cooking skills are awakening?!

Mr. Gourmand, you shouldn't have!
This won't do. Come follow me to the kitchen right away!
Thank you! Thank you so much!
How could I ever repay you, Mr. Gourmand? Oooh, maybe I can become your personal chef?
It'd make me so happy if you enjoyed my cooking every single day!
My heart flutters every time you taste my cooking.
I'll make sure that you never have another bad meal for the rest of your life!
Did someone call for a chef?
Yes!
Oooh, I've never seen these types of ingredients before.
Quite a bunch of bad apples here.
Let me do the dishes real quick.
I'll have to wrap this up before the food gets cold.
Once I'm done, I'll make you something tasty.
Bubble bubble! Sizzle sizzle!
Cooking these guys up is a real hassle.
Time to add some seasoning.
All the ingredients are gathered!
I'll pour my heart into this dish!
Enjoy your meal!
One more plate, coming up!
The dishes are done!
The ingredients are prepped!
Agh!
Wahh!
Ouuch...!
Urgh... I wasn't able to complete the dish...
All finished cooking! Now then, what do you say we sit down for a nice meal?
